summary.text: Amanda Janoo is a first-time candidate and economist who has worked in economic development for the United Nations and with the Wellbeing Economy Alliance. She proposes higher taxes on top earners, second homes and large tech companies' digital advertising revenue; she says the income surcharge would fund free primary and preventive health care and second-home revenue would reduce property taxes.

paragraphs.text: Political newcomer; has worked in economic development for the United Nations and in economic sustainability with the Wellbeing Economy Alliance.
Won the Democratic nomination in August 2026.
